title: Manicouagan Reservoir
description: This lake is a perfect ring, 70 kilometers across. Manicouagan in Canada is the scar of an asteroid that hit 214 million years ago. Imagery: Esri, Maxar, Earthstar Geographics. Photos: NASA Johnson Space Center, Wikimedia Commons. Source: Wikipedia.

beats.text: This lake is a perfect ring, seventy kilometers across.
It is Manicouagan, in Canada. People call it the eye of Quebec.
The ring is a scar. A five kilometer asteroid hit right here.
That was two hundred fourteen million years ago.
The crater it blasted was a hundred kilometers wide.
But the lake is new. A dam flooded the ring in the nineteen sixties.
And the island in the middle is bigger than the lake around it.
